score_definition: Internal craft judgment, not an objective test, professional SLP approval, owner/child acceptance, physical print proof or master-audit release-proven satisfaction. 4.9 marks a near-final visual target with no observed actionable defect in that object/category at the reviewed evidence size. Scores were revised only when the recorded defect was actually corrected; generation count alone does not establish quality.
scoring_scope: Principal characters, story-bearing props, visible marginal objects, scene/composite integrity, typography and visual story/pacing are listed per page. Individual paper grains, anonymous sand speckles and identical perimeter dots are texture families, not separate story objects. Grouped effects such as intact bubble piles are reviewed as a visual object family.

original_comparison.final_comparison: The book now has actual event-specific lower-bank compositions instead of interchangeable brushes/suds. Full-art pages carry action and setting; contour-cutout pages allow pauses, dialogue and detail. The banks stay subordinate to the main action and vary between supplies, mirror/duck play, rubbish, fountain/hug, apology toys, attic fear/couch spectators, cooperative toys and rest. Existing original-book rectangles or larger props were not treated as permission to relax current owner rules.

bank_geometry.result: All eleven annotated final backgrounds pass the visible-object gates. bank_geometry.grounding: Objects contact the blue bank plane with natural local shading/occlusion; no square backing or floating pasted prop was found.
bank_geometry.measurement_limit: Conservative manual visible-object bounds were checked at native size and against color cores. Exact pre-occlusion silhouettes, hidden bottom-10% area and shadow opacity cannot be recovered from flattened generated images; those values are not claimed as measured.

bubble_and_compression.native_review: Final selected banks, full-art bath/pool scenes, coherent ceiling derivatives, bubble transformation pages and nap scene were inspected at native/source and final PNG sizes. Closed rings and painted highlights are intact. Pale blue mottling, fine paper grain and intentional painted stone/bubble stipple are texture; no JPEG block grid, smeared ring cluster or corrupted outline was found in the final reviewed evidence.
bubble_and_compression.encoding_result: Every inspected embedded image uses FlateDecode. The PDF adds no JPEG recompression; this does not by itself prove the original source was defect-free.
bubble_and_compression.native_resolution_limit: Most generated native masters are 1484 by 1060, approximately 212 ppi at 7 by 5 inches. The 1512 by 1080 proof render is not a claim of new 300-ppi detail.

hidden_lamma.visuals: Two recognizable small white plush faces with side ears and gentle canonical facial cues: towel basket and toy chest. Neither is named or prompted in story text.
hidden_lamma.status: INTERNAL_VISUAL_TARGET_MET; whether the child finds them at the intended difficulty remains child/owner acceptance.

review_limitations: Visual comparison and numerical craft scores are reviewer judgments rather than clinical, device or owner evidence.
